facts: [cpu] reason I_KRR_NO_DATA (info): KRR gave no cpu recommendation (Not enough data); using this tool's own figure instead.
[cpu] reason C_THROTTLED (block): CPU is throttled in 60% of periods: the container is hitting its CPU limit, so observed usage understates demand.
[memory] reason I_KRR_NO_DATA (info): KRR gave no memory recommendation (Not enough data); using this tool's own figure instead.
[memory] reason I_FLOOR (info): Candidate 5Mi is below the minimum 32Mi; using the minimum.
limitation: Workload name is inferred from the pod name.
limitation: Revisions are not tracked, so samples from different releases are mixed.
limitation: Usage figures are the highest value across pods (conservative).
limitation: p50/p95/max use a 5-minute CPU rate; peak_1m uses a 1-minute rate and is still limited by the scrape interval.
limitation: No latency, error-rate or SLO data is included.
limitation: History covers about 0.4 h of the requested 3.0 h window.
